architecture_style: loosely coupled prototype components: a Vue/Node/WebSocket client-relay path plus an independent Swing MVC-style HTTP client and separate API test artifacts; not one layered production application
scope_notes: Based on .geninsights/analysis/analysis_results.json and cross-checks of the Java, Vue, Node, API contract, test, and launch/build sources.
The visible domain is an Allegro-oriented person/address/payment form prototype; no HR application is evidenced.
There are two separate Swing entry points: websocket.Main is a WebSocket receiver; com.Main launches the com.poc MVC-style HTTP submission client.
The Vue client searches in-memory fixtures and sends WebSocket messages to the Node relay at ws://localhost:1337/.
The Node service is a WebSocket broadcast relay; it is not the localhost:8080 HTTP POST endpoint.
The repository does not implement the /post HTTP server. api.yml is a contract artifact and the Cucumber/RestAssured project is test code.
No database, durable persistence, backend search service, or complete integrated deployment is shown.

layers.name: Browser Client
layers.description: Presentation, local fixture search and selection, and WebSocket message production; no server-side search.

layers.name: WebSocket Relay
layers.description: Accepts WebSocket connections on port 1337 and broadcasts received UTF-8 text frames to connected clients.

layers.name: Standalone Swing WebSocket Client
layers.description: Independent desktop UI and WebSocket endpoint; routes recognized message targets into its own form.

layers.name: Separate Swing MVC Client
layers.description: Independent form application with view/presenter/model responsibilities and local event notification.

layers.name: HTTP Integration and Verification Artifacts
layers.description: Java HTTP client and separate API contract/test artifacts. The HTTP server is not implemented in this repository; this zone is not an application layer shared by all components.

components.name: Vue Search client (Search.vue; fixtures embedded)
responsibilities: Render a person/address/payment mock form and search results.
Search a hard-coded in-memory fixture list.
Send target/content JSON text over WebSocket for selected form data and textarea changes.

components.name: Node WebSocket relay (WebsocketServer.js)
responsibilities: Host a WebSocket server on an HTTP server listening at port 1337.
Track active client connections.
Broadcast incoming UTF-8 message text to every connected client, including the sender.

components.name: websocket.Main Swing receiver
responsibilities: Construct an independent Swing form.
Connect to ws://localhost:1337/ using the Java WebSocket client.
Parse JSON-P messages and route recognized textarea/textfield targets into form controls.

components.name: com.Main composition root
responsibilities: Construct PocView, EventEmitter, PocModel, and PocPresenter for the separate com.poc application.

components.name: PocView
responsibilities: Build the form controls and expose inputs, text area, gender controls, and submit button to the presenter.

components.name: PocPresenter
responsibilities: Bind view controls to model values.
Invoke model submission when the com.poc form button is clicked.
Receive in-process response events and update/reset visible controls.

components.name: PocModel
responsibilities: Hold enum-keyed mutable form values.
Convert values to strings and orchestrate HTTP submission.
Emit response-derived text through the local EventEmitter.

components.name: EventEmitter
responsibilities: Store listeners and synchronously notify them with emitted string data.

components.name: HttpBinService
responsibilities: Serialize a string-valued map as JSON and POST it to http://localhost:8080/post.
Read and return the HTTP response body.

components.name: api.yml OpenAPI contract
responsibilities: Describe a POST /post operation and request/response schema.

components.name: Cucumber / RestAssured API test project
responsibilities: Prepare scenario request data and submit POST requests.
Assert configured API response expectations; does not implement the API server.
dependencies: Configured API target outside the test client

patterns_identified.description: The com.poc Swing application separates view construction, presenter bindings, and model/submission behavior. This applies only to that Swing entry point, not the WebSocket Swing UI or the whole repository.
EventEmitter stores listeners and invokes them synchronously; PocPresenter subscribes to response text from PocModel. This is not a distributed event broker.
The Node process relays each received UTF-8 frame to all connected clients without interpreting its payload.
Search is performed over a hard-coded in-memory array in the Vue component; there is no search API or persistence layer.
Cucumber and RestAssured construct requests and assert responses against a configured target. Test code and api.yml do not implement a server.

external_dependencies.name: Referenced HTTP POST endpoint at localhost:8080/post
external_dependencies.purpose: Target used by HttpBinService and described by api.yml; API tests also express expectations for a configured POST target.
external_dependencies.implementation_status: Not implemented in this repository; the Node service implements only the separate WebSocket relay.

protocols.name: WebSocket
protocols.payload: UTF-8 text; Vue sends JSON with target and content fields; relay broadcasts to all connected peers.

protocols.name: HTTP
protocols.payload: application/json POST; endpoint server is absent from this repository.
